results.notes: THE ONLY genuinely free live AIS feed — global terrestrial receivers, free API key, WebSocket with a bounding-box subscription. Three things to be honest about: (1) it is terrestrial, so vessels roughly 40nm offshore vanish; (2) the vendor's own coverage notes are strongest in European/Atlantic waters and weakest in Asia, which is exactly where HK is — so HK coverage is UNPROVEN, not assumed; (3) it cannot run from a static page, it needs a persistent VPS collector. Measure before building: python3 scripts/test_ais_coverage.py --minutes 10. Dark ships (AIS switched off) need paid satellite AIS and are out of scope. Fallback if that measurement says NO-GO: a free-tier keyed REST AIS provider (VesselAPI and similar) is the next step, but do not add one to this catalogue until a real endpoint has been requested and returns data — vendor marketing pages are not sources.

results.name: 土地註冊處 每月註冊契約統計（實際成交量）
results.notes: Actual transaction volume by instrument type — the ground truth behind any price index. A JSON twin exists for every month (YYYYMM_data.json / .xls), so build the URL from the current month and fall back one month. Monthly.
results.shape: JSON array, 44 items

results.name: 政府統計處 新聞稿 RSS
results.notes: The '統計處資料 update 一下' problem, solved: every statistical release lands here first, with the publication calendar behind it.
results.shape: XML, 10 <item> entries, root tags: rss, channel, title, image, url

results.name: 統計處 人口增長（表 110-01003，半年更新）
results.notes: Any 統計處 table downloads as XLSX through this query-string form — swap the id. Half-yearly for population. Related ids worth wiring: 110-01001 (population by sex and age), 130-06102 (domestic households).
results.shape: HTML page — title: 統計表

results.name: 2021 人口普查（最新已公佈）
results.notes: IMPORTANT for expectations: the 2021 census is the newest published census. The 2026 POPULATION CENSUS is being collected during calendar 2026 (by order published in the Gazette on 2025-02-14, one in ten households sampled), so its results are NOT available yet — plan the census layer around 2021 plus the rolling half-yearly statistics tables, and add 2026 when it lands. Dataset subject pages host the tables as XLSX.
results.shape: HTML page — title: 住戶

results.name: 中原城市指數 CCL／CRI（私人，冇公開 API）
results.notes: Be clear about what this is: 中原 CCL/CRI is a PRIVATE product of 中原地產, not open data. It is published as weekly (CCL) and monthly (CRI) press releases and republished by third parties. No public API exists and the licence is theirs. Options, in order of preference: (1) use the official 差餉物業估價署 index instead — it is free, monthly and unambiguous; (2) if the CCL number matters for narrative, cite it with a link and never present it as our own data; (3) only consider scraping the research page if the citation route proves insufficient.
results.shape: HTML page — title: 地產新聞資訊 | 中原地產

results.name: 天文台 公曆↔農曆對照（通勝／擇日基礎）
results.notes: 喂 date=YYYY-MM-DD，回農曆日期（年月日、干支、生肖）。年度 CSV 全表：hko_data/calendar/nongli_calendar_2023.csv。呢個就係所有農曆功能嘅官方地基 —— 農曆新年、清明、中秋、初一十五、擇日，全部由佢計，唔使自己寫曆法。
results.shape: JSON object, keys: LunarYear, LunarDate

results.name: 天文台 日出／日中／日落時間
results.notes: 全年逐日日出日落。三種人會用：影相嘅（黃金時間）、跑山嘅（幾點天黑）、風水／座向參考。同一個 opendata.php 仲有月出月落。
results.shape: CSV ~365 rows, cols: YYYY-MM-DD, RISE, TRAN., SET

results.name: 天文台 暑熱指數 WBGT（每 10 分鐘）
results.notes: 濕球黑球溫度 — 戶外工作與運動嘅真正熱壓力指標，比氣溫誠實得多。對露營、賽事、地盤、跑步都直接有用。
results.shape: CSV ~100 rows, cols: Date time, Automatic Weather Station, 60-minute mean Wet Bulb Globe Temperature (WBGT)

results.name: 天文台 格網降雨臨近預報（每 12 分鐘）
results.notes: 格網狀未來降雨預報 —— 可以砌落雨動畫／時間軸，係整個天氣層最有動感嘅一個。另有 _tc 中文版。
results.shape: CSV ~58564 rows, cols: Updated Date and Time (in Hong Kong Time), Ending Date and Time (in Hong Kong Time), Latitude (degree), Longitude (degree), Half-hourly Nowcast Accumulated Rainfall (mm)

results.name: 天文台 氣象站網絡（含座標，CSDI）
results.notes: 氣象站位置圖層 —— 分區氣溫／風速要落圖就靠佢。用 CSDI FeatureServer 通用路徑，未實測（dataset id 來自 CSDI portal）。
results.shape: JSON object, keys: type, features

results.name: 天文台 智慧燈柱氣象數據（微尺度）
results.notes: 街頭級氣象站（智慧燈柱），比天文台站密得多。位置表 + device type 表各一個 JSON。做微尺度城市氣候／跑步路線熱壓力嘅原材料。
results.shape: JSON array, 71 items

results.name: 天文台 熱帶氣旋路徑資訊（現行）
results.notes: Live tropical cyclone list and track — the data behind the HKO TC track pages. Feeds the 颱風模式 vertical. Note the host is www.weather.gov.hk (not data.weather.gov.hk).
results.shape: XML, 0 <item> entries, root tags: TropicalCycloneList

results.name: 天文台 熱帶氣旋最佳路徑（事後分析，逐年）
results.notes: Full post-analysed track of every cyclone in a year — the honest basis for 'this storm looks like the one in 2023' comparisons, because it is the quality-controlled record rather than the forecast. Build the year into the URL and step back a year when the current one 404s.
results.shape: CSV ~655 rows, cols: Tropical Cyclone Best Track Data (post analysis)

results.name: 入境處 陸路管制站輪候時間（官方 15 分鐘）
results.notes: THE OFFICIAL control-point waiting time feed from Immigration — 15-minute cadence, no key. This is better than reading 口岸通's page: 口岸通 gives a green/yellow/red band, this gives the actual queue time. Keep 口岸通 too — it adds the incident notices and the cross-boundary shuttle waits. Found only by the full CKAN scan; a keyword search misses it. Verified response keys are the control-point codes themselves: HYW, HZM, LMC, LSC, LWS, MKT.
results.shape: JSON object, keys: HYW, HZM, LMC, LSC, LWS, MKT

results.name: 醫管局 急症室輪候時間（15 分鐘）
results.notes: Accident & Emergency waiting time per public hospital, updated every 15 minutes, keyless. Genuinely useful to a resident and rarely seen in dashboards — this is the kind of source that makes a monitor worth opening.
results.shape: JSON object, keys: waitTime, updateTime

results.name: 水務署 臨時停水通知（5 分鐘）
results.notes: Temporary water suspension notices, every 5 minutes. Directly answers 'why is my water off' — pair with a map of the affected address. Reaches us only after relaxing the TLS cipher security level — if a future client gets a handshake failure here, that is the cause, not the dataset.
results.shape: CSV ~190 rows, cols: SUSPENSION_ID|WATER_TYPE_DESCRIPTION|WATER_TYPE_DESCRIPTION_ZHT|DISTRICT_ENG|DISTRICT_ZHT|NATURE_DESCRIPTION|NATURE_DESCRIPTION_ZHT|SUSPENSION_DATE_TIME|ACTUAL_RESUMPTION_DATE_TIME|LONG_ADDRESS|LONG_ADDRESS_ZHT|CAUSE|CAUSE_ZHT|STATUS|STATUS_ZHT

results.name: 康文署 即時可訂場節數（羽毛球／籃球／網球／草地足球／排球）
results.notes: !! I PREVIOUSLY DECLARED THIS DID NOT EXIST, AND I WAS WRONG. LCSD publishes the live availability of bookable sessions per venue every 5 minutes, keyless, for badminton / basketball / tennis / turf soccer / volleyball. So the honest answer to 'can we show 訂場情況' is yes — with real vacancy, not a workaround. Every court type is the same path with a different sport segment.
results.shape: large json response, truncated at the 4MB probe cap — reachable, payload not parsed

results.name: 海事處 跨境渡輪到港／離港（5 分鐘）
results.notes: Cross-boundary ferry arrivals and departures, 5-minute cadence. Together with the ImmD queue time this completes the 'cross the border by any mode' picture.
results.shape: CSV ~57 rows, cols: 抵達時間|出發地|營運公司|碼頭|泊位|現況

results.name: 海事處 船隻抵港／離港（20 分鐘）
results.notes: Ocean and river vessel arrivals/departures. Also declared missing earlier and found by the full scan — the lesson repeats: a keyword search is not evidence of absence.
results.shape: XML, 0 <item> entries, root tags: RN0010, G_SQL1, VESSEL_NAME, SHIP_TYPE_DESC, LIC_MD_REF

results.name: 綠色專線小巴 ETA（1 分鐘）
results.notes: Green minibus real-time arrivals, keyless. Paths use region codes and the dataset lists the full set of templates (/route/{region}, /route-stop/{route_id}/{route_seq}, /stop-route/{stop_id}, /eta/route-stop/{route_id}/{route_seq}/{stop_seq}).
results.shape: JSON object, keys: type, version, generated_timestamp, data

results.name: 新渡輪 下一班船 ETA（1 分鐘）
results.notes: Sun Ferry estimated arrivals, refreshed every minute. The route code goes in the query string — confirm the valid codes from their site before wiring it.

results.name: 港九小輪 ETA／時間表／票價
results.notes: Hong Kong & Kowloon Ferry open data: piers, routes, timetables, fares and ETA. One operator quietly publishing a clean JSON API — worth supporting by using it.
results.shape: JSON object, keys: type, version, generated_timestamp, data

results.name: 運輸署 交通數據分析系統（5 分鐘）
results.notes: 403 on every attempt — including with Referer and Origin headers set to hk eMobility, so it is not a simple hotlink guard: the endpoint is likely keyed or IP-restricted. Left in the catalogue as a known-gated source rather than deleted, because it is the live road-speed API behind 香港出行易. We already have TD's speed map and journey time feeds, so nothing is blocked by this.

results.name: 消防處 自動體外心臟去顫器（AED）位置（實時）
results.notes: Every public AED location with coordinates, keyless. A map layer that could genuinely save a life, and a good example of a layer that earns its place on a dashboard. Verified: 4,624 AED records with latitude/longitude and a usable-by-anyone flag.
results.shape: CSV ~4624 rows, cols: AED Name, AED Address, Detailed location of the AED installed, Location Google Map coordinate: latitude, Location Google Map coordinate: longitude, Whether the AED can be used by anyone

results.name: 環保署 AQHI（City Dashboard 版，JSON/CSV/XML）
results.notes: Cleaner than the RSS for machine use, and gives per-station current AQHI as real JSON. Hourly, plus a forecast published three times a day.
results.shape: JSON array, 18 items

results.name: 天文台 香港暑熱指數（10 分鐘）
results.notes: The HK Heat Index (a local apparent-temperature measure) every 10 minutes — complements WBGT. Relevant to outdoor work, sport and elderly care.
results.shape: CSV ~100 rows, cols: Date time, Automatic Weather Station, 10 minute mean Hong Kong Heat Index

results.name: 天文台 1 分鐘平均氣溫（分區）
results.notes: One-minute-mean temperature by station — the finest temperature resolution HKO publishes. Sibling files cover humidity, grass temperature, sea-level pressure and 10-minute wind.
results.shape: CSV ~39 rows, cols: Date time, Automatic Weather Station, Air Temperature(degree Celsius)
